draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Glad week one has gone smoothly, and happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever it's useful. Would a short call this week work? I can keep it to 20 minutes and focus on whatever's most useful for Silver Logistics now that there's a second person in the workspace.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so we can look at how you want the real work mapped out. If a call isn't the right fit yet, just reply and I'll help over email instead.

Best,
Chidi
